name: B10-0408/2025 – § 1/2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Second World Summit for Social Development
part_text: as well as put forward legislative initiatives
part_context: Considers that the Commission and the Member States should step up their efforts to implement the EPSR, in line with the La Hulpe Declaration and through an ambitious update of the Action Plan, to achieve the 2030 headline targets; calls on the Commission, as part of the updated Action Plan, to complement the current headline targets, as appropriate, as well as put forward legislative initiatives for the full implementation of the EPSR;
